Description: Unverified registration is resumed instead of refused (existing ID from commit a5c447e; prior result not recorded in repo)
Test steps: 1. Start registration with the same phone number. 2. Continue the flow.
Expected result: Flow resumes the unverified registration; no refusal

Description: Development banner is visible on customer pages
Test steps: 1. Open the public home page. 2. Read the top banner.
Expected result: Banner states local development / mock OTP / synthetic data

Description: Customer registration with a new synthetic phone and name
Preconditions: Tester has Tailscale access; phone number is fake and not used by anyone
Test steps: 1. Open /register. 2. Enter name and fake phone. 3. Submit.
Expected result: Account created with status REGISTERED; DEV CODE shown on screen

Description: OTP verification with the correct DEV CODE
Test steps: 1. Enter the DEV CODE on /verify. 2. Submit.
Expected result: Phone verified; status moves to APPROVAL_PENDING; login is not yet allowed

Description: OTP wrong code rejected and repeated failures are limited
Test steps: 1. Enter a wrong code 5 times. 2. Observe the message.
Expected result: Wrong code rejected each time; rate limit message after repeated failures; generic message

Description: OTP resend issues a new code and invalidates the old one
Test steps: 1. Click resend. 2. Enter the old code. 3. Enter the new code.
Expected result: Old code rejected; new code accepted

Description: Customer login with an approved account
Test steps: 1. Open /login. 2. Enter phone and password. 3. Submit.
Expected result: Logged in; header shows the customer name; /account accessible

Description: Invalid password rejected with a generic message
Test steps: 1. Enter correct phone and wrong password. 2. Submit.
Expected result: Generic invalid credentials message; no session cookie

Description: Login blocked for a pending-approval account
Test steps: 1. Log in with the pending account.
Expected result: Login refused with an approval-pending message; no session

Description: Owner login at the staff login page
Preconditions: Owner account active with MANAGER role (owner performs this test)
Test steps: 1. Open /admin/login. 2. Sign in with owner credentials.
Expected result: Admin dashboard at /admin is shown

Description: Customer account rejected at the staff login page
Test steps: 1. Open /admin/login. 2. Sign in with the customer account.
Expected result: Access denied; no admin session

Description: Password recovery request
Test steps: 1. Open /recover. 2. Enter phone. 3. Request code.
Expected result: Recovery code shown (DEV CODE) and request accepted without revealing whether the account exists

Description: Password recovery confirm sets a new password
Test steps: 1. Enter the recovery code and a new password. 2. Log out. 3. Log in with the old password. 4. Log in with the new password.
Expected result: Old password fails; new password works

Description: Logout revokes the server-side session
Test steps: 1. Log out. 2. Reuse the old session cookie on /api/v1/auth/me (e.g. with browser devtools copy).
Expected result: Logout succeeds; reused cookie returns 401

Description: Session expiry after SESSION_HOURS
Preconditions: Logged in customer; SESSION_HOURS is 12 by default. Expiry needs a time skip, so the owner performs it with an approved DB change or waits
Test steps: 1. Stay idle or let the session expire. 2. Click a protected page.
Expected result: Redirected to login; API returns 401

Description: Password change revokes other sessions
Preconditions: Customer logged in on two browsers
Test steps: 1. Change password at /account/password in browser A. 2. Use browser B.
Expected result: Browser B is logged out on its next request

Description: Suspended or rejected account cannot log in
Preconditions: Owner has suspended one test account
Test steps: 1. Log in with the suspended account.
Expected result: Login refused with a status message; no session

Description: New registration appears in the owner's approval queue
Test steps: 1. Owner opens /admin/customers. 2. Filter by approval pending.
Expected result: The new customer is listed with APPROVAL_PENDING

Description: Owner approves a customer and assigns a price level
Test steps: 1. Owner opens the customer. 2. Assign a price level. 3. Approve.
Expected result: Status ACTIVE; price level saved; history entry created

Description: Owner rejects a customer
Test steps: 1. Owner rejects the customer. 2. Tester attempts login.
Expected result: Login refused; status REJECTED

Description: Price level change is visible to the customer
Preconditions: Approved customer with a price level
Test steps: 1. Owner changes the price level. 2. Tester refreshes catalog.
Expected result: Tester sees the prices for the new level

Description: Suspend and reactivate a customer
Preconditions: Approved customer logged in as tester
Test steps: 1. Owner suspends. 2. Tester refreshes. 3. Owner reactivates. 4. Tester refreshes.
Expected result: Suspended: session no longer works. Reactivated: login works again

Description: Customer cannot open admin customer pages or APIs
Test steps: 1. Open /admin/customers. 2. Call /api/v1/admin/customers in the browser.
Expected result: Access denied; no customer data shown

Description: Owner creates a category
Test steps: 1. Open /admin/categories. 2. Create a category in English and Arabic. 3. Save.
Expected result: Category saved and listed

Description: Owner creates a product model and SKU
Test steps: 1. Open /admin/catalog. 2. Create a model and a SKU with attributes and price.
Expected result: SKU saved; visible in admin list

Description: Product image upload and display
Test steps: 1. Upload a valid JPG to the SKU. 2. Tester opens the product page.
Expected result: Image uploads and is shown to the tester

Description: Invalid product image rejected
Test steps: 1. Upload a text file renamed to .jpg. 2. Upload a file over the size limit.
Expected result: Both rejected with a clear validation error; nothing stored

Description: Product edit is shown to customers after refresh
Test steps: 1. Owner changes the product name. 2. Tester refreshes the product page.
Expected result: Updated name shown; no stale data

Description: Product search in English and Arabic
Test steps: 1. Search by SKU code. 2. Search by English name. 3. Search by Arabic name.
Expected result: Matching products returned in each case

Description: Price visibility depends on the customer's price level
Preconditions: Two approved customers with different price levels
Test steps: 1. Log in as customer A, view prices. 2. Log in as customer B, view prices. 3. Log out, view as anonymous.
Expected result: Each sees only their own level; anonymous sees no customer price

Description: Inventory quantity set by adjustment
Test steps: 1. Owner opens /admin/inventory. 2. Adjust quantity up. 3. Adjust down with a reason.
Expected result: Balance changes; movement recorded with reason

Description: Inventory adjustment below zero rejected
Test steps: 1. Adjust down by more than the stock.
Expected result: Rejected; balance unchanged

Description: Price change recorded in history
Test steps: 1. Owner changes a tier price at /admin/catalog SKU prices.
Expected result: New price shown; price change history entry created

Description: Bulk product import preview and commit
Test steps: 1. Fill synthetic rows. 2. Upload for preview. 3. Fix an error row. 4. Commit.
Expected result: Errors listed in preview; committed rows match; no duplicate SKUs

Description: Arabic / English interface and RTL layout
Test steps: 1. Switch language on the home page. 2. Open a product page and a cart.
Expected result: Text translates; layout flips to RTL in Arabic; no broken labels

Description: Brands and categories browsing
Test steps: 1. Open /catalog. 2. Filter by category and brand.
Expected result: Filtered results are correct

Description: Add an in-stock product to the cart
Test steps: 1. Open a product. 2. Add quantity 2 to cart. 3. Open /cart.
Expected result: Item and quantity shown; totals correct

Description: Cart quantity above stock is blocked
Test steps: 1. Add a quantity greater than stock.
Expected result: Blocked with a clear message; cart unchanged

Description: Bulk add and quick order
Test steps: 1. Use /quick-order or /bulk-order with several SKUs. 2. Include one invalid SKU. 3. Add.
Expected result: Valid lines added; invalid line reported; nothing silently dropped

Description: Checkout quote shows totals and delivery
Preconditions: Items in cart; delivery address exists
Test steps: 1. Open /checkout. 2. Choose an address.
Expected result: Quote matches cart totals and shipping rule

Description: Place a cash-on-delivery order
Test steps: 1. Submit the order.
Expected result: Order number issued; cart empty; order visible in /orders

Description: Double-submit creates only one order
Test steps: 1. Click submit twice quickly. 2. Refresh during submit.
Expected result: Exactly one order created

Description: Order visible in admin dashboard
Test steps: 1. Owner opens /admin/orders.
Expected result: New order listed with correct customer, items and total

Description: Order status progression and customer tracking
Test steps: 1. Owner: hold, lock-prep, pick, pack, check, handover. 2. Tester refreshes /orders/[id] after each step.
Expected result: Each status change is visible to the tester; audit entries created

Description: Stock reserved on order and released on cancellation
Test steps: 1. Tester places order. 2. Check stock. 3. Cancel the order (UAT-ORD-010).
Expected result: Stock decreases on order and returns on cancellation

Description: Customer cancellation request and owner decision
Test steps: 1. Tester submits a cancel request. 2. Owner approves or rejects.
Expected result: Request visible to owner; outcome shown to tester

Description: Customer sees only own orders
Preconditions: Two customers each with an order
Test steps: 1. Tester A lists orders. 2. Tester A opens the URL of tester B's order.
Expected result: Only own orders listed; other order not shown

Description: Reorder from a previous order
Test steps: 1. Open an old order. 2. Click reorder.
Expected result: Items added to cart; unavailable items reported

Description: Favorites and recently viewed
Test steps: 1. Add a favorite. 2. View products. 3. Open /account/favorites and /account/recent.
Expected result: Lists updated; removal works

Description: Delivery address management
Test steps: 1. Add, edit and delete an address at /account/addresses.
Expected result: Changes saved; deleted address no longer selectable

Description: Merge proposals response
Preconditions: Two orders eligible for merge (if the feature is in use)
Test steps: 1. Tester opens merge proposal. 2. Accept or decline.
Expected result: Response recorded; order state correct

Description: Fulfillment job and print view
Test steps: 1. Owner opens /fulfillment and a job. 2. Print.
Expected result: Job details and printable view render correctly

Description: Last unit ordered by two testers at the same time
Preconditions: SKU with exactly 1 unit; two approved customers
Test steps: 1. Both add the item to cart. 2. Both submit checkout at the same moment.
Expected result: Exactly one order succeeds; the other is told the stock is unavailable; stock never negative

Description: Owner changes price while a customer is checking out
Preconditions: Customer in checkout; owner has admin access
Test steps: 1. Customer opens checkout. 2. Owner changes the price. 3. Customer submits.
Expected result: Order uses the price shown or the customer is asked to confirm the new price; no silent mismatch

Description: Simultaneous customer and admin sessions
Preconditions: Tester and owner logged in at once
Test steps: 1. Both work in their own areas for 10 minutes.
Expected result: No cross-session data leaks; both sessions stay valid

Description: Logout in one browser does not affect the other session
Preconditions: Two browsers, same user or two users
Test steps: 1. Log out in browser A. 2. Use browser B.
Expected result: Browser B still logged in

Description: Owner stock adjustment while item is in tester's cart
Test steps: 1. Owner reduces stock below the cart quantity. 2. Tester checks out.
Expected result: Checkout blocked or adjusted with a clear message

Description: Customer direct URL access to admin and back-office pages
Test steps: 1. Open /admin, /admin/orders, /accounting, /fulfillment, /admin/reports directly.
Expected result: Each denied or redirected to login; no data shown

Description: Unauthenticated admin API calls are denied
Test steps: 1. Call /api/v1/admin/orders, /customers, /settings, /audit from a browser with no session.
Expected result: 401 for each
Actual result: Partly run locally on 2026-11-18: 401 for all tested admin endpoints. Remote re-run pending

Description: Cross-origin write request rejected through the tailnet URL
Test steps: 1. From a page on another origin (or curl with Origin: https://evil.example), send a POST to a write endpoint with the tester session cookie.
Expected result: 403 Cross-origin request rejected; no change in data
Actual result: Partly run locally: 403 for cross-origin POST without session. Session-based re-test pending

Description: Customer cannot change own price level or role by tampering with requests
Test steps: 1. Send a profile or cart request with another priceLevelId or role field.
Expected result: Field ignored or rejected; stored values unchanged

Description: Customer cannot access another customer's address or order by changing the ID
Test steps: 1. Use the ID of the other customer's order or address in the URL and in the API.
Expected result: 404 or 403; no data

Description: Tester cannot reach other services on the owner's computer
Preconditions: Tester on Tailscale with the final ACL
Test steps: 1. From the tester machine try https://<tailnet-ip>:443 (expected reachable only via Serve name), http://<tailnet-ip>:3200, :5440, :445, :139, :135, :7070, :80.
Expected result: Only the SupplyNest HTTPS URL works. All others refused or time out

Description: Application not reachable directly on tailnet or LAN IP
Test steps: 1. From another device on the tailnet or LAN open http://<tailnet-ip>:3200 and http://192.168.68.116:3200.
Expected result: Connection refused or timed out

Description: Admin page shell reveals no data without login
Test steps: 1. Open /admin without a session. 2. Check the page text and network responses.
Expected result: Only a login prompt; no records, counts or names

Description: Login error does not reveal whether a phone number is registered
Test steps: 1. Try a known phone with a wrong password. 2. Try an unknown phone.
Expected result: Same generic message for both

Description: Product image upload rejects non-image and oversized files
Test steps: 1. Upload an executable renamed to .png. 2. Upload a body over 12 MB.
Expected result: Rejected with validation error; not stored

Description: Security headers present through the tailnet URL
Test steps: 1. Open the tailnet URL. 2. Inspect response headers in browser devtools.
Expected result: X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy present; Cache-Control private no-store

Description: Rate limit cannot be bypassed by changing X-Forwarded-For
Test steps: 1. Send repeated bad logins while changing X-Forwarded-For each request.
Expected result: Limit still applies after repeated failures

Description: Application process killed; automatic recovery
Test steps: 1. Owner finds the node process on port 3200 and stops it. 2. Wait up to 5 minutes. 3. Tester refreshes.
Expected result: Application back within about 5 minutes; data intact

Description: Database container interruption and recovery
Preconditions: Stack running; no test in progress
Test steps: 1. Owner runs docker stop b2b-store-postgres. 2. Tester sees error page. 3. Wait for supervisor, or docker start.
Expected result: Errors shown without data loss; service returns; data unchanged

Description: Browser refresh during checkout does not duplicate orders
Test steps: 1. Start checkout. 2. Refresh at each step.
Expected result: No duplicate order

Description: Tester Tailscale disconnect and reconnect
Test steps: 1. Tester disconnects Tailscale. 2. Reconnects. 3. Refreshes the app.
Expected result: Access restored; session still valid or re-login required cleanly

Description: Tailscale Serve survives a Tailscale service restart
Test steps: 1. Owner restarts the Tailscale service (Windows Services). 2. Tester reconnects.
Expected result: Serve config still present; URL works

Description: Windows restart recovery
Test steps: 1. Owner restarts the computer. 2. Owner signs in. 3. Check status-local.ps1 and the tailnet URL.
Expected result: Stack, Serve and data restored after sign-in

Description: Data persistence after application restart
Test steps: 1. Note order numbers. 2. Restart the application. 3. Check orders and accounts.
Expected result: All records present unchanged
